column3: Quarterly Shift Plan for the Eastside Clinic
The clinic runs two shifts on most weekdays. Teams rotate every quarter to share the evening work.
Table 1. Teams on duty by day and shift
Each team leader confirms the rota by the last Friday of the month. Swaps between teams must be approved by the duty manager.
The clinic is closed on Wednesdays while the staff training programme runs. Room 3 is reserved for vaccinations on Thursdays.
